blocks.text: **wish** ning bir nechta qolipi bor va ularni adashtirish oson. Hozirgi holatdan afsus — **I wish I knew** (→ 39-dars), o'tmishdagi afsus — **I wish I had known** (→ 40-dars). Bu darsda ular qisqa takrorlanadi va yana ikkita qolip qo'shiladi: kimgadir **tilak** bildirish (I **wish** you luck) va **norozilik** yoki o'zgarish istagi (I **wish** you **would** listen!). Shuningdek **hope** va **wish** farqi — o'zbekcha «tilamoq» va «umid qilmoq» ga tayanib tushuntiriladi.

**wish** + kishi + **ot** — kimgadir yaxshilik tilash: I **wish** you **luck** / **every success** / **a happy birthday** / **a safe journey**. Xat oxirida **Best wishes** — «Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan». **Wish me luck!** — «Menga omad tila!». Lekin kelajakdagi yaxshi narsa haqida **gap** (ega + fe'l) bilan aytilsa, **hope** ishlatiladi: I **hope** you **have** a great holiday, «I wish you have a great holiday» emas. O'zbekchadagi «tilayman» → wish + ot, «umid qilaman» → hope + gap.

items.text: We all **wish** you **a speedy recovery** — get well soon!
items.translation: Hammamiz sizga **tezroq sog'ayib ketishingizni tilaymiz** — tuzalib keting!

items.text: I **hope** you **have** a wonderful time in London.
items.translation: Londonda ajoyib vaqt o'tkazasiz, deb **umid qilaman**.

blocks.text: **hope** — real imkoniyat: bo'lishi mumkin, biz uni xohlaymiz. Undan keyin odatda hozirgi zamon (kelajak ma'nosida ham): I **hope** it **doesn't rain** tomorrow. **wish** + gap — xayol: haqiqat boshqacha, biz uni o'zgartira olmaymiz: I **wish** it **wasn't** raining (lekin yog'yapti). Oddiy test: natija hali noma'lum va bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa — **hope**; haqiqat allaqachon ma'lum va u bizga yoqmasa — **wish**.

rows: I **wish** I **had passed** the exam. (o'ta olmadim)
I **wish** Kate **were** at home. (u uyda emas)
We **hope** to visit Khiva next year.
We **wish** we **could** visit Khiva, but we can't afford it.

blocks.text: I wish ... would — o'zgarish istagi va norozilik

**wish** + kishi (yoki narsa) + **would** + fe'l — kimdir biror ishni **qilishini** (yoki qilishni to'xtatishini) xohlaymiz, lekin bunga unchalik ishonmaymiz. Ko'pincha **norozilik** ohangida: I **wish** you **would** listen to me! — Gapimga **quloq solsang-chi**! **wouldn't** — yomon odatdan norozilik: I **wish** he **wouldn't** leave his socks on the floor. Narsalar va ob-havo haqida ham: I **wish** it **would** stop raining — **Qani endi** yomg'ir **to'xtasa**. O'zbekchada: «**...sang-chi**», «**bas qilsang-chi**», «**qani endi ...sa**».

items.text: I **wish** you **would** put your phone away while we're having dinner.
Aziz **wishes** his colleagues **wouldn't** send him emails late at night.
items.translation: Aziz **qani endi** hamkasblarim yarim tunda xat **yuborishmasa**, deydi.

blocks.text: wish ... would yoki wish + o'tgan zamon?

**would** — **harakat yoki o'zgarish** istagi: kimdir nimadir qilsin. **Holat** fe'llari (be, have, know, live) bilan esa o'tgan zamon ishlatiladi: I wish Kate **were** here, «I wish Kate would be here» emas. O'zingiz haqingizda «I wish I would ...» deyilmaydi: I wish I **could** ... yoki I wish I **didn't** ... deng. Solishtiring: I wish it **wasn't** raining — hozirgi holatdan afsus; I wish it **would stop** raining — o'zgarishni kutish, sabrsizlik.

items.text: I **wish** the bus **would** come — I've been standing here for half an hour.
items.translation: **Qani endi** avtobus **kelsa** — yarim soatdan beri shu yerda turibman.

items.text: I **wish** this bus **wasn't** so crowded — I can hardly breathe.
items.translation: **Qani endi** bu avtobus bunchalik **tiqilinch bo'lmasa** — nafas olish ham qiyin.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I wish you have a nice trip» → I **hope** you have a nice trip yoki I **wish** you **a nice trip**; «I wish I would be taller» → I wish I **was / were** taller (holat — o'tgan zamon); «I wish I would have more time» → I wish I **had** more time; «I wish I would have known» → I wish I **had known**; «I wish my brother would be here» → I wish my brother **were** here.

wish dan keyingi qismni tanlashda vaqtni so'rang: **hozirgi holat** → Past Simple (I wish I **had** ...); **o'tmish** → Past Perfect (I wish I **had had** ...); **boshqa kishining harakati, o'zgarish** → would (I wish you **would** ...). Tilak bo'lsa — wish + kishi + **ot**: I wish you **luck**.

rows: We **wish** you a happy new year.

examples.title: **wish** somebody **luck**: good wishes
examples.description: wish + kishi + ot — kimgadir yaxshilik tilash: luck, success, a happy birthday, a safe journey. O'zbekchada «tilamoq».

sentences.text: We **wish** you a very happy birthday and lots of success in the coming year.
sentences.translation: Sizni tug'ilgan kuningiz bilan tabriklab, kelgusi yilda katta **muvaffaqiyatlar tilaymiz**.

sentences.text: **Wish** me luck — my driving test is at nine tomorrow morning!
sentences.translation: Menga **omad tila** — haydovchilik imtihonim ertaga ertalab soat to'qqizda!

sentences.text: Everyone in the office **wishes** you a speedy recovery, Aziz.
sentences.translation: Aziz, ofisdagi hamma sizga tezroq **sog'ayib ketishingizni tilaydi**.

sentences.text: The whole team **wished** Bekzod good luck before his presentation to the investors.
sentences.translation: Butun jamoa investorlarga taqdimotidan oldin Bekzodga **omad tiladi**.

sentences.text: Please **wish** your parents a happy anniversary from all of us.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, barchamiz nomidan ota-onangizni turmush **yilligi bilan tabriklang**.

sentences.text: I**'d like to wish** you all a merry Christmas and a peaceful New Year.
sentences.translation: Barchangizga quvnoq Rojdestvo va tinch Yangi yil **tilashni istardim**.

sentences.text: Kate **wished** us a safe journey as we set off for Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Edinburgga yo'lga chiqayotganimizda Keyt bizga **oq yo'l tiladi**.

sentences.text: Before the exam, our teacher **wished** every student the best of luck.
sentences.translation: Imtihon oldidan ustozimiz har bir talabaga **omad tiladi**.

sentences.text: All of us **wish** you the very best in your new job in London — we'll miss you!
sentences.translation: Hammamiz Londondagi yangi ishingizda sizga **eng yaxshi narsalarni tilaymiz** — sizni sog'inamiz!

sentences.text: Madina's grandparents **wished** the young couple a long and happy life together.
sentences.translation: Madinaning buvi-buvasi yosh kelin-kuyovga uzoq va baxtli **hayot tilashdi**.

examples.title: **hope** or **wish**?
examples.description: hope — real imkoniyat, natija noma'lum; wish — xayol, haqiqat boshqacha. Juft gaplarda solishtiring.

sentences.text: I **hope** you have a wonderful time in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda ajoyib vaqt o'tkazasiz, deb **umid qilaman**.

sentences.text: We **hope** the weather stays dry for the wedding on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Shanba kungi to'yda havo quruq bo'ladi, deb **umid qilamiz**.

sentences.text: I **wish** the weather **was** better — it's been raining for a week.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** havo yaxshiroq **bo'lsa** — bir haftadan beri yomg'ir yog'yapti.

sentences.text: Sarah **hopes** she **gets** the job, because the interview went really well.
sentences.translation: Suhbat juda yaxshi o'tgani uchun Sara ishga **qabul qilinishiga umid qiladi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **wishes** she **had** a job, but nobody has called her back yet.
sentences.translation: Sara **qani endi** ishim **bo'lsa**, deydi, lekin hali hech kim qayta qo'ng'iroq qilmadi.

sentences.text: **Let's hope** the new manager **is** better than the old one.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer eskisidan yaxshiroq **bo'lishiga umid qilaylik**.

sentences.text: Tom **hopes** to visit Uzbekistan next year, if he can save enough money.
sentences.translation: Tom yetarlicha pul yig'a olsa, kelasi yil O'zbekistonga **borishni umid qiladi**.

sentences.text: Tom **wishes** he **could** visit Uzbekistan, but he can't take time off work.
sentences.translation: Tom **qani endi** O'zbekistonga **bora olsam**, deydi, lekin ishdan javob ololmaydi.

sentences.text: Thanks again for your help — **hoping** to see you in Bukhara soon!
sentences.translation: Yordamingiz uchun yana rahmat — tez orada Buxoroda **ko'rishishga umid qilaman**!

sentences.text: My parents **hope** I'll come home for the holidays, and I **wish** I **could**, but flights are too expensive.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam ta'tilga uyga kelishimga **umid qilishadi**, men ham **qani endi kela olsam**, lekin aviachiptalar juda qimmat.

examples.title: **I wish** + past: the present situation
examples.description: Takrorlash (→ 39-dars): wish + Past Simple — hozirgi holatdan afsus. Haqiqat — teskarisi.

sentences.text: I **wish** I **had** more energy in the mornings — I need three coffees to wake up.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** ertalablari kuchim ko'proq **bo'lsa** — uyg'onish uchun uch piyola qahva ichishim kerak.

sentences.text: Kate **wishes** she **lived** in the centre, because the commute takes nearly two hours.
sentences.translation: Keyt **qani endi** markazda **yashasam**, deydi, chunki ishga borish qariyb ikki soat oladi.

sentences.text: Don't you **wish** you **knew** what other people really think of you?
sentences.translation: Boshqalar siz haqingizda aslida nima o'ylashini **bilishni** xohlamaysizmi?

sentences.text: We **wish** there **were** more green parks in our part of the city.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** shaharning biz yashaydigan qismida yashil bog'lar ko'proq **bo'lsa**.

sentences.text: Jasur **wishes** his boss **wasn't** so strict about coming in at exactly nine.
sentences.translation: Jasur **qani endi** boshlig'im soat roppa-rosa to'qqizda kelishga bunchalik **qattiqqo'l bo'lmasa**, deydi.

sentences.text: Sometimes I **wish** I **didn't** have to make so many decisions every day.
sentences.translation: Ba'zan **qani endi** har kuni shuncha ko'p qaror **qabul qilishim shart bo'lmasa**, deyman.

sentences.text: My little brother **wishes** he **was** old enough to drive.
sentences.translation: Ukam **qani endi** mashina haydashga yoshim **yetsa**, deydi.

sentences.text: How we all **wish** the summer holidays **were** a bit longer!
sentences.translation: Yozgi ta'til biroz uzunroq **bo'lishini** hammamiz qanchalik xohlaymiz!

sentences.text: Emma **wishes** she **knew** more about Uzbek wedding traditions, as she's going to one next week.
sentences.translation: Emma **qani endi** o'zbek to'y an'analari haqida ko'proq **bilsam**, deydi, chunki kelasi hafta to'yga boradi.

sentences.text: Honestly, I **wish** my job **wasn't** so far from home.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, **qani endi** ishim uydan bunchalik **uzoq bo'lmasa**.

examples.title: **I wish** + past perfect: regrets
examples.description: Takrorlash (→ 40-dars): wish + Past Perfect — o'tmishdagi afsus. O'zbekchada «qani endi ...gan bo'lsam», «...ganiga afsuslanadi».

sentences.text: I **wish** I**'d brought** a warmer coat — it's freezing in Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** issiqroq palto **olib kelgan bo'lsam** — Edinburgda qahraton sovuq.

sentences.text: Bekzod **wishes** he **had studied** IT instead of economics.
sentences.translation: Bekzod iqtisod o'rniga IT **o'qimaganiga afsuslanadi**.

sentences.text: We **wish** we **hadn't booked** such a cheap hotel — the walls were paper-thin.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** bunchalik arzon mehmonxonani **band qilmagan bo'lsak** — devorlari qog'ozdek yupqa edi.

sentences.text: Nilufar **wishes** she**'d kept** in touch with her school friends.
sentences.translation: Nilufar maktabdagi do'stlari bilan **aloqani uzib qo'yganiga afsuslanadi**.

sentences.text: If only you**'d told** me earlier — I could have helped!
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** menga oldinroq **aytgan bo'lsang** — yordam bera olardim!

sentences.text: Do you ever **wish** you **had chosen** a different career?
sentences.translation: Hech boshqa kasb **tanlamaganingizga afsuslanasizmi**?

sentences.text: The players must **wish** they **hadn't celebrated** so early — the other team scored in the last minute.
sentences.translation: O'yinchilar shunchalik erta **bayram qilganlariga afsuslanayotgan bo'lsa kerak** — raqib jamoa oxirgi daqiqada gol urdi.

sentences.text: Oliver **wishes** he **had saved** more money when he was younger.
sentences.translation: Oliver yoshligida ko'proq **pul jamg'armaganiga afsuslanadi**.

sentences.text: Looking at the bill, Madina **wished** she **hadn't ordered** the most expensive dish.
sentences.translation: Hisobga qarab, Madina eng qimmat taomni **buyurtma qilganiga afsuslandi**.

sentences.text: Now I really **wish** I**'d taken** more photos of my grandmother.
sentences.translation: Endi buvimni ko'proq **suratga olmaganimga** juda **afsuslanaman**.

examples.title: **wish** ... **could**: abilities and chances
examples.description: wish + could — qobiliyat yoki imkoniyat yo'qligidan afsus. O'zbekchada «qani endi -a olsam».

sentences.text: I **wish** I **could** help you, but I'm not allowed to share that information.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** sizga **yordam bera olsam**, lekin bu ma'lumotni berishga ruxsatim yo'q.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **wishes** she **could** spend more time with her kids.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **qani endi** bolalarim bilan ko'proq vaqt **o'tkaza olsam**, deydi.

sentences.text: We **wish** we **could** stay longer in Khiva, but our train leaves tonight.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** Xivada uzoqroq **qola olsak**, lekin poyezdimiz bugun kechqurun jo'naydi.

sentences.text: Aziz **wishes** he **could** afford a flat of his own.
sentences.translation: Aziz **qani endi** o'z kvartiramni **sotib olishga qurbim yetsa**, deydi.

sentences.text: Don't you **wish** you **could** fly home instead of sitting in traffic every evening?
sentences.translation: Har kuni kechqurun tirbandlikda o'tirish o'rniga uyga **uchib keta olishni** xohlamaysizmi?

sentences.text: Grandpa **wishes** he **could** still walk to the bazaar on his own.
sentences.translation: Bobom **qani endi** bozorga hali ham o'zim **yurib bora olsam**, deydi.

sentences.text: Sometimes I **wish** I **could** switch off my phone for a whole week.
sentences.translation: Ba'zan **qani endi** telefonimni bir haftaga **o'chirib qo'ya olsam**, deyman.

sentences.text: Sarah **wishes** she **could** sing, because her whole family is very musical.
sentences.translation: Sara **qani endi qo'shiq ayta olsam**, deydi, chunki butun oilasi juda musiqiy.

sentences.text: My son **wishes** he **could** go to school by bike like his friends.
sentences.translation: O'g'lim **qani endi** do'stlarimdek maktabga velosipedda **bora olsam**, deydi.

sentences.text: James can't swim, and on holiday he really **wishes** he **could**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms suza olmaydi, ta'tilda esa **qani endi suza olsam**, deb juda afsuslanadi.

examples.title: **I wish** you **would** ...: complaints and requests
examples.description: wish + kishi + would — boshqa odam o'z xatti-harakatini o'zgartirishini xohlaymiz; ko'pincha norozilik. O'zbekchada «...sang-chi».

sentences.text: Honestly, I **wish** you **would** stop interrupting me when I'm talking.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, gapirayotganimda gapimni **bo'lishni bas qilsang-chi**.

sentences.text: Mum **wishes** my brother **would** tidy his room without her having to remind him.
sentences.translation: Oyim **qani endi** ukam xonasini eslatmasam ham **yig'ishtirsa**, deydi.

sentences.text: We **wish** the neighbours **would** park their car somewhere else.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** qo'shnilar mashinasini boshqa joyga **qo'yishsa**.

sentences.text: Madina **wishes** her husband **would** help more with the cooking.
sentences.translation: Madina **qani endi** erim ovqat pishirishda ko'proq **yordam bersa**, deydi.

sentences.text: I do **wish** you**'d listen** to me for once!
sentences.translation: Hech bo'lmasa bir marta gapimga **quloq solsang-chi**!

sentences.text: The manager **wishes** the staff **would** answer customers' emails more quickly.
sentences.translation: Menejer **qani endi** xodimlar mijozlarning xatlariga tezroq **javob berishsa**, deydi.

sentences.text: Everyone **wishes** the government **would** do something about rising rents.
sentences.translation: Hamma **qani endi** hukumat ijara narxlarining o'sishiga qarshi biror **chora ko'rsa**, deydi.

sentences.text: Kate **wishes** Tom **would** call her more often while he's working abroad.
sentences.translation: Keyt **qani endi** Tom chet elda ishlayotganida menga tez-tez **qo'ng'iroq qilsa**, deydi.

sentences.text: Jasur, I **wish** you**'d tell** me what's wrong instead of sulking.
sentences.translation: Jasur, xafa bo'lib o'tirmasdan, nima bo'lganini **aytsang-chi**.

sentences.text: Don't you **wish** people **would** turn their phones off in the cinema?
sentences.translation: Odamlar kinoteatrda telefonlarini **o'chirib qo'yishsa** yaxshi bo'lardi, demaysizmi?

examples.title: **wish** ... **would** / **wouldn't**: bad habits
examples.description: wish + narsa yoki kishi + would — o'zgarishni kutish va sabrsizlik; wouldn't — yoqmaydigan odat.

sentences.text: It's been raining for days — I **wish** it **would** stop!
sentences.translation: Bir necha kundan beri yomg'ir yog'yapti — **qani endi to'xtasa**!

sentences.text: I **wish** the bus **would** hurry up — we've been waiting for forty minutes.
sentences.translation: **Qani endi** avtobus **kela qolsa** — qirq daqiqadan beri kutyapmiz.

sentences.text: Oliver **wishes** his flatmate **wouldn't** leave dirty dishes in the sink.
sentences.translation: Oliver **qani endi** xonadoshim iflos idishlarni rakovinada **qoldirmasa**, deydi.

sentences.text: My sister **wishes** her baby **would** sleep through the night, just once.
sentences.translation: Opam **qani endi** chaqalog'im bir marta bo'lsa ham tun bo'yi **uxlasa**, deydi.

sentences.text: Please slow down! We all **wish** you **wouldn't** drive so fast.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, sekinroq! Bunchalik tez **haydamasang-chi** — hammamiz shuni xohlaymiz.

sentences.text: Bekzod **wishes** his phone **would** stop showing him adverts every five minutes.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **qani endi** telefonim har besh daqiqada reklama **ko'rsatishni to'xtatsa**, deydi.

sentences.text: Sarah **wishes** her colleague **wouldn't** keep borrowing her pens and never giving them back.
sentences.translation: Sara **qani endi** hamkasbim ruchkalarimni olib, qaytarmay **yurishni bas qilsa**, deydi.

sentences.text: Look at that queue! I **wish** they**'d open** another checkout.
sentences.translation: Anavi navbatni qara! **Qani endi** yana bitta kassa **ochishsa**.

sentences.text: Farmers in the region **wish** it **would** rain — the fields are completely dry.
sentences.translation: Viloyatdagi fermerlar **qani endi yomg'ir yog'sa**, deyishadi — dalalar butunlay qurib qolgan.

sentences.text: Grandma **wishes** we **wouldn't** spend so much time on our phones at the dinner table.
sentences.translation: Buvim **qani endi** dasturxon atrofida telefonlarimizga bunchalik ko'p **qarab o'tirmasak**, deydi.

examples.title: Dialogue: two flatmates
examples.description: Suhbat: ikki xonadosh — wish ning barcha qoliplari bitta suhbatda: would, Past Simple, Past Perfect, could va tilak.

sentences.text: — Kate, I **wish** you**'d wash up** after dinner sometimes.
sentences.translation: — Keyt, ba'zan kechki ovqatdan keyin **idishlarni yuvsang-chi**.

sentences.text: — Sorry! I **wish** I **had** more time, but I'm working late every day this month.
sentences.translation: — Kechir! **Qani endi** vaqtim ko'proq **bo'lsa**, lekin bu oy har kuni kechgacha ishlayapman.

sentences.text: — I know. And I **wish** I **hadn't shouted** at you yesterday about the music.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman. Kecha musiqa uchun senga **baqirganimga afsuslanaman**.

sentences.text: — It's fine. I **wish** the walls **weren't** so thin, then you wouldn't hear it.
sentences.translation: — Hechqisi yo'q. **Qani endi** devorlar bunchalik **yupqa bo'lmasa**, unda sen eshitmasding.

sentences.text: — Exactly. And I **wish** the landlord **would fix** the heating before winter.
sentences.translation: — Aynan. Yana **qani endi** uy egasi qishdan oldin isitishni **tuzatsa**.

sentences.text: — Let's call him tomorrow. I **hope** he **answers** this time!
sentences.translation: — Ertaga unga qo'ng'iroq qilaylik. Bu safar javob berar, deb **umid qilaman**!

sentences.text: — Me too. Honestly, I sometimes **wish** we **could** find a better flat.
sentences.translation: — Men ham. Rostini aytsam, ba'zan **qani endi** yaxshiroq kvartira **topa olsak**, deyman.

sentences.text: — Really? I'd miss this place. I just **wish** it **was** a bit quieter.
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Men bu joyni sog'inardim. Faqat **qani endi** biroz tinchroq **bo'lsa**.

sentences.text: — Fair enough. Oh, and I **wish** you **wouldn't borrow** my milk without asking!
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri. Ha, yana bir narsa: so'ramasdan sutimni **olib qo'ymasang-chi**!

sentences.text: — Ha! Deal. And I **wish** you **good luck** with that big project at work.
sentences.translation: — Ha-ha! Kelishdik. Ishdagi o'sha katta loyihangda senga **omad tilayman**.
